name: Bergland
beschreibung: The holiday apartment Ferienwohnung Bergland is situated in the picturesque village of Ellmau in Tyrol. Designed for independent self-catering stays, the accommodation features a fully equipped kitchen, multiple comfortable bedrooms, and a bathroom. Set in peaceful surroundings, the apartment boasts delightful views of the surrounding alpine scenery. From Ellmau, scenic walking trails and the renowned ski resort SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser – Brixental are within easy reach. The village offers diverse shopping venues and welcoming restaurants, making the apartment an excellent choice for families and small travel groups.
